value.body: Video editors turn raw footage into finished pieces: news packages, short social videos, ads, interviews or longer shows. News channels, digital media outlets, production houses and brand content teams hire them. Most of the day is at the edit desk, working to a brief and a deadline.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BJMC, BA, or a film / editing course

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Non-linear editing software, audio tools, basic motion graphics

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hiring is based on a showreel. Freshers often start as assistant editors, interns in newsrooms, or freelancers editing short-form content, and build a portfolio from there.

value.title: At a glance
items: Newsroom editing runs on shifts; freelance work pays per project.
Short-form social video has added many entry-level openings.
Next steps: senior editor, post-production supervisor, or video producer.
